name: Leena Thampi

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Leena Thampi writes English poetry alongside her work as an entrepreneur. Her Literary Vibes contributor note traces her upbringing from Jammu to Delhi and lists collections including Rhythms of a Heart, Autumn Blaze, An Allusion to Time and Embers to Flames. Her writing returns to emotional experience through the seasons, music and the natural world.

Her Kabita Live poems range from the ache of waiting in ‘Gossamer Dreams’ to the sustaining presence of a mother in ‘Golden Womb’. ‘A Kite’s Fate’ asks readers to look beyond appearances and recognise another person’s hidden struggles, while ‘Serendipity’ follows a woman turning hurt into writing. Across these different situations, memory and affection become ways of imagining renewal.
